source: Six learner attempts saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Explica/Explícame and indirect why explanation requests
summary: Correct Explica esta función, then attached me in explícame. Accent first absent, then misplaced; corrected stress retained in three subsequent prompts. Correct indirect-why readiness, inability and need clauses. Publicarla/probarla remained infinitives after podemos/necesitamos. Final review/explain sequence retained object, command forms and feminine agreement; remaining accents supplied.

observations.outcome: Correct explica after explicar → explica model, with appropriate esta función. Standard spelling supplied. Tutor then introduced explica + me → explícame and stress-preserving accent.
Correct attached me and standalone esto after the model. Accent supplied. Tutor next prompted explanation with por qué.

observations.learnerText: Explicáme por que la funcion no esta lista
observations.correctedText: Explícame por qué la función no está lista.
observations.outcome: Correct explanation clause, subject and feminine agreement. Accent misplaced on explícame; tutor emphasized ex-PLÍ-ca-me. Supplied qué, función and está accents.

observations.learnerText: Explícame por que no podemos publicarla
observations.correctedText: Explícame por qué no podemos publicarla.
observations.outcome: Correct explícame accent after correction, indirect why clause and no podemos + publicarla for feminine object. Only qué accent supplied.
Correct transfer to necesitamos + infinitive probarla, retaining proper explícame accent. Only qué accent supplied.

observations.learnerText: Primero revisala; luego explícame por que no esta lista
observations.correctedText: Primero revísala; luego explícame por qué no está lista.
observations.outcome: Correct two direct commands, explicit object retained in revísala, indirect explanation and feminine readiness agreement. Explícame accent retained; revísala, qué and está accents supplied.

nextSteps: Use a self-chosen explanation or action instruction
Recheck explícame stress after intervening material
Continue earlier command and publishing-spelling reviews during work
assessmentNote: Models, accent correction and transfer conditions explicit. Correct clause formation is separate from qué accent correction; no long-term mastery inferred.
